notes: Intro: B2B adtech platform providing real-time bid-time personalization and reranking for display/native auctions.
Primary ask: sub-20ms p95 inference for short prompts (<= 64 tokens) at sustained 2k-5k req/s for candidate scoring.

Cost sensitivity: unit economics are strict — want to understand tradeoffs between batching (amortize token cost) vs hard latency SLOs; looking for 40-60% cost reduction vs their current cloud GPU spend.
Optimize interest: explicit ask for batching/caching recommendations, quantization profile advice (INT8/4-bit), and an A/B perf/quality benchmark across model variants.
Security: VPC + SSO/SAML required; SOC2/ISO references must be present; encryption KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated/Private.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-18): "We can tolerate tiny quality delta if p95 and cost improve materially. Need deterministic fallbacks if quantized path regresses."
They run a hybrid infra footprint: ingestion in us-east, ML scoring in us-west for scale — need routing by region and predictable benchmarks per region.
POC constraints: use anonymized production traffic replay (10M small requests), Redwood to provide perf baseline and recommended batching/caching knobs.
Legal: wants Redwood MSA + SOC2 appendix, data residency clause for EU customers (if Dedicated/Private used across regions).

technical_requirements: Latency target: p95 <= 20ms for single-candidate scoring (<=64 tokens)
Throughput target: sustained 2k-5k req/s with burst to 10k/s during peak auctions
Quality target: reranking NDCG drop <= 2% vs FP16 baseline
Operational needs: per-route dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, tracing hooks for request->model mapping
Fallbacks: automatic fallback to FP16 or larger model if quantized path exceeds quality threshold
Model preferences: open models (e.g., Llama2/Mistral variants) with Redwood-verified perf profiles; willing to test 4-bit quantized artifacts
Caching approach: prefix/profile KV caching and per-campaign static embeddings cache; open to continuous batching but must honor latency SLOs
poc_plan: Phase 1 (week 0-2): Replay anonymized production traffic — baseline runs (FP16) across us-east/us-west
Phase 2 (week 2-4): Run INT8 and 4-bit quantized experiments + automated quality validation on holdout set
Phase 3 (week 4-6): Evaluate batching/caching configs recommended by Redwood Optimize; measure cost per 1M requests
Acceptance criteria: p95 latency <=20ms AND quality NDCG delta <=2% AND projected cost reduction >=30%
